stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Tom Gibbs - great to have Future Golf with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 8 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Made the Turn Count
stories.detail: The round pivoted at the turn - found something on 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 15-18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Going Rogue
stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 17 & 18 - the field is on notice

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 17, 3-pointer on hole 18 - that's better

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 11 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 19 on the front, 12 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: Clean but Not Pretty
stories.detail: 8 1-pointers and not a single wipe - disciplined mediocrity

stories.title: Pristine
stories.detail: Zero wipes from 16 holes - the scorer has not written a zero yet

comingLast.roast: at 1.1 a hole the blue balls were never really in doubt
4 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
on 18 at 1.4 a hole - the presentation table is being set
in the clubhouse 3 above Donoghue - cheering for him from a safe distance
finished 4 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
finished 5 above the blue line - toasting every point Donoghue does not score
finished 5 above Donoghue - close enough to keep his speech drafted
in with a 5-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
5 clear and finished - now a full-time Donoghue supporter
